action: If you received a notice, enrol in the free credit monitoring offered where your Social Security number was involved, and check insurance statements for services you did not receive.
exec: Two intrusions in five months at one specialist provider point to incomplete remediation and repeated notification cost.
plain: A Minnesota epilepsy clinic was hacked for the second time this year, exposing personal and medical details of about 82,500 people.
summary: The Level 4 epilepsy centre detected unauthorised network access on August 10, confirmed on September 17 that personal and health information was compromised, and began mailing notices on October 16. The incident affects 82,574 people; an earlier intrusion from March 16 to April 10 affected 80,061. Exposed data may include Social Security numbers, treatment and insurance information. No attacker is named.
title: Minnesota Epilepsy Group reports second cyberattack of 2026, affecting 82,574 people

validation.note: One trade outlet reporting the organisation's breach notice.
